name: Audricus Phagnasay

attribution.legal_posture: Convicted by guilty plea and sentenced on March 19, 2026 in S.D. Ga. docket 1:25-cr-00061-JRH-BKE to three years of probation, a $2,000 fine, and a $100 special assessment, with restitution recorded as $0 and $681,926 forfeiture. Probation supervision later transferred to E.D. Cal. docket 1:26-cr-00093-KES; the transfer left the conviction and sentence unchanged.

caveats: The later public transfer-packet source independently supplies the controlling signed judgment; this record follows that judgment for imprisonment terms.
The controlling signed judgment establishes probation, fine, assessment, no-restitution, and forfeiture terms; imprisonment carries no imposed term.

The E.D. California docket records a probation-supervision transfer and administrative closure; it preserves the conviction's procedural history without creating a second prosecution, new sentence, or dismissal of the conviction.
Only defendant-specific plea, sentence and role facts in the cited DOJ release are assigned to this person; aggregate enforcement totals remain separate.
This is an administrative transfer of probation supervision and closure of the transfer docket; second prosecution, new sentence, dismissal of the conviction, and merits change fall outside it.
This is an exact sentence-detail correction; conviction or sentencing status is unchanged.
